svg.text: Able to recover after difficulty or adapt when
Our team stayed resilient through several setbacks
and found a workable way forward.
Adjective. Common patterns: resilient people, a
resilient community, resilient in the face of difficulty.
It does not mean never feeling upset.
A: The first launch was rough. How is the team
B: They have been resilient. They regrouped and
A: So being resilient does not mean they were
B: Right. They were disappointed, but they adapted
Describe a resilient person or group. Explain what
